_meta.description: Trusted Summit experience archetypes. These describe the overall behavior, rhythm, and interaction style a generated website should use before individual sections are chosen.
_meta.selection_rule: Pick one primary archetype per generated site. Use category profiles as content guidance, not as the full visual recipe.

premium_editorial.label: Premium Editorial
premium_editorial.description: A polished magazine-like experience with strong imagery, generous spacing, restrained reveals, and copy that feels curated rather than templated.

background_system.notes: Use real scraped imagery whenever available. Background texture should be subtle and never compete with photography.

scroll_system.notes: Sections should arrive with slow reveal timing and occasional image parallax on desktop.

nav_system.notes: Compact sticky nav with a clear booking or contact CTA. Avoid large multi-row nav.

cta_system.behavior: Persistent but quiet. Use sticky CTA only when a real destination exists.

prompt_guidance: Prioritize original scraped photos, team details, service names, and proof.
Use asymmetrical editorial layouts instead of uniform card grids whenever content supports it.
Keep motion quiet enough that the business still feels premium and trustworthy.

tech_launch.label: Tech Launch
tech_launch.description: A modern product-launch feel with controlled ambient backgrounds, crisp proof blocks, sticky conversion, and a sense of interactive polish.

background_system.notes: Use one controlled animated gradient or spotlight hero system. Keep text contrast high.

scroll_system.notes: Use scroll reveals to introduce capabilities, outcomes, and proof as a sequence.

nav_system.notes: Sticky nav may use blur or translucency if contrast remains readable.

cta_system.behavior: Use sticky CTA after the hero and repeat the same action in the final band.

prompt_guidance: Make the layout feel custom through sequencing, not by adding fake software language.
Use ambient effects only in one or two major areas.
Do not invent dashboards, apps, or product screenshots unless scraped content proves they exist.

local_service_conversion.label: Local Service Conversion
local_service_conversion.description: A practical, high-trust service site focused on phone calls, fast comprehension, service area confidence, and above-the-fold conversion.

background_system.notes: Prefer clean bands, mild texture, and service-relevant imagery over decorative animation.

scroll_system.notes: Use short reveal timing to keep the page feeling fast and useful.

nav_system.notes: Phone, quote, or emergency action must stay easy to reach.

cta_system.behavior: Sticky CTA is encouraged when a real phone number or quote destination exists.

prompt_guidance: Do not bury the phone number or primary action.
Use motion only to improve scanning, never to create a splash-screen feeling.
Make services and service area concrete using scraped content.

gallery_led.label: Gallery Led
gallery_led.description: A visual-first experience for businesses where proof lives in real work photos, projects, food, spaces, transformations, or portfolio imagery.

background_system.notes: Let real imagery carry the visual system. Background animation should be secondary.

scroll_system.notes: Use staggered reveals and desktop parallax for selected large images.

nav_system.notes: Navigation should help jump to gallery, services, story, and booking.

cta_system.behavior: CTA should appear after visual proof, with an optional sticky repeat on longer pages.

prompt_guidance: Use actual scraped imagery as the main differentiator.
Avoid repeating equal-size card rows for every section.
Do not fabricate portfolio items, menu items, or before-and-after claims.

luxury_calm.label: Luxury Calm
luxury_calm.description: A serene, high-trust experience with minimal motion, careful whitespace, tactile details, and confidence through restraint.

background_system.notes: Use quiet background color, fine borders, and occasional soft gradients without active visual noise.

scroll_system.notes: Prefer fade or very small translate reveals with longer easing.

nav_system.notes: Sticky nav should feel calm and compact, with no flashing or pulsing CTA.

cta_system.behavior: Use repeated CTAs in natural positions instead of aggressive persistent prompts.

prompt_guidance: Make the site feel expensive through composition, spacing, and real detail.
Avoid loud color transitions, pulses, bounces, and busy decorative backgrounds.
Use fewer sections if the scraped content is thin.

utility_dashboard.label: Utility Dashboard
utility_dashboard.description: A dense but polished operational layout for businesses that need clear comparison, schedules, services, locations, menus, or structured decision paths.

background_system.notes: Use clear bands, tables, lists, and compact modules. Decorative motion should be almost absent.

scroll_system.notes: Motion should only clarify grouping and hierarchy.

nav_system.notes: Tabs or anchor nav are appropriate when users need to compare content quickly.

cta_system.behavior: Keep actions close to the relevant structured content.

prompt_guidance: Prefer scannable grouped content over oversized marketing sections.
Use compact cards, rows, and tabs only when they make repeated decisions easier.
Keep motion subtle so users can compare details without distraction.
